newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Centennial rated a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Centennial rated a sell.

text.p: Brokerage firm Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phil) Inc said on Thursday it has downgraded its recommendation on real estate developer Centennial City Inc to a sell from a buy due to uncertainties over its property project in Manila Bay.

"Most of City's earnings prospects were supposed to have come from the Amari project but with the sale being questioned, the case has become complicated. We do not see an immediate resolution, so we recommend a sell," said Raul Ruiz, vice president at Sun Hung Kai.
Centennial has a 20 percent stake in the Thai-Philippine Amari consortium, which has proposed a 750-hectare reclamation project along Manila Bay.
The award to Amari by the Public Estates Authority has been questioned by a senator who claimed the property was undervalued.
Centennial rose by 5 centavos to 3.10 pesos in mid-morning trade on Thursday. A total of 307,000 Centennial shares had changed hands.
